description: Pre-1.0.0 major-protection. While a project is still below version 1.0.0 the public surface is considered unstable, so a breaking-change commit must NOT escalate to the 1.x line automatically; instead it is downgraded one level and bumps the minor component (resetting patch). This protection only applies to the automatic recommendation path. Input gives a starting version below 1.0.0 and a breaking-change commit; output reports the recommended next version.

ops.commit: feat!: this is a breaking change
